# Excerpt of https://play.google.com/robots.txt as read on 12 Nov 2026 (one `User-Agent: *`
# group, 107 lines live): the Disallow rules the radar depends on, copied verbatim. No rule
# matches /store/apps/details, so details pages are allowed.

Allow: /store/devices

Disallow: /store/apps/datasafety*
Disallow: /store/people/details
Disallow: /_
Disallow: /store/search
Disallow: /store/getreviews
Disallow: /store/apps/collection/p3_details_*
